mining_power.balanced_detail:
Everydzień mining using about half of your telefon’s CPU cores. Easy on heat for most people.

Tip: Change the CPU number yourself and the app switches to Własny automatically.
mining_power.performance_detail:
Aims for higher hashrate by preferring the telefon’s faster cores when it has them.

May use more power and run warmer. Best when plugged in and cooled well.

On simple telefons without “fast/slow” cores, this matches Balanced.
mining_power.cooler_detail:
Uses fewer cores than Balanced so the telefon stays cooler and bateria lasts longer.

Good for overnight or warm rooms. Switch back to Balanced when you want more speed.
mining_power.custom_detail:
Full manual control. CPU starts from your General setting (or 1).

Temperatura and bateria pauses use simple defaults you can change.

Pick Balanced, Performance, or Cooler again anytime to re-apply that profile.

general.network_debug_detail:
What it does: Adds a network debug button on the mining screen (works in normal release builds too). It logs whether Wi‑Fi is on, signal strength, and if the pool is reachable.

Why enable it: When mining keeps “retrying”, it is hard to tell if the pool is down or the telefon put Wi‑Fi to sleep. These logs make that clear so you can fix the right telefon setting instead of guessing.

Turn it off anytime if you do not need the extra button.

power.intro_detail:
Mining keeps talking to the pool over Wi‑Fi (or mobile data) even when the screen is off. Phones try to save power by sleeping apps and Wi‑Fi. When that happens you lose the connection, see endless “retry” messages, and earn less — even though the app looks like it is still running.

A few one-time telefon settings keep the link stable for overnight mining. It only takes a minute and is the most common fix for mysterious disconnects.
power.wifi_detail:
What to do:
• Older telefons — Wi‑Fi settings → Wi‑Fi preferences → Wi‑Fi sleep policy. Pick option 3, “Never”.
  1. When screen turns off — not good for mining (Wi‑Fi sleeps)
  2. Never when charging — OK if you always mine while plugged in
  3. Never — best choice for stable mining
• Newer telefons — also turn off “turn off Wi‑Fi when screen is off”, “adaptive connectivity”, or similar power-saving Wi‑Fi options (names vary by brand: Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, Pixel, etc.).

Why this helps: The mining pool needs a live connection the whole time. If Wi‑Fi sleeps with the screen, the pool drops you and hashrate stalls until you wake the telefon.
power.oem_detail:
What to do: In Urządzenie care, Bateria, or App power management, put VerusMiner on the “never sleep”, “unrestricted”, or “no restrictions” list. You can re-open app details anytime to confirm.

Why this helps: Many brands add extra bateria savers on top of Android. Those can still kill mining even after the normal bateria setting looks fine. Whitelisting VerusMiner stops those surprise stops.
power.notification_detail:
What to do: While mining, leave the VerusMiner notification in the status bar. Do not swipe it away.

Why this helps: That small notification tells Android the app is actively working. Without it, the telefon is more likely to pause mining in the background.
power.locks_detail:
What to do: Nothing extra — VerusMiner does this for you while mining.

Why this helps: The app asks Android to keep the CPU and Wi‑Fi radio from napping during a session. This helps, but it cannot turn Wi‑Fi back on if you (or the telefon brand) fully disabled it — still complete the steps above.
power.game_detail:
What the app can do: While mining, VerusMiner sends a GameState “gameplay active” hint (Android 13+) so the system may prefer higher clocks. That is not the same as forcing Game Mode = Performance on every brand.

What to do if you have Game Mode / Game Launcher / Game Booster:
1. Otwórz Game Launcher, Game Space, Game Turbo, or Game Mode in system settings.
2. Add VerusMiner to the game list if needed.
3. Set the mode to Performance (not Bateria Zapiszr / Balanced).
4. Leave thermal / “auto FPS” limits off if you only care about CPU mining.

Dotknij “Apply performance hint” to re-send the hint and open app details.

Note: May increase heat and power use. Best when plugged in. Skip if your telefon has no Game Mode.
power.remind_detail:
What it does: When on, VerusMiner shows this checklist each time you start mining.

Why enable it: Phone updates or bateria-saver changes can reset your settings. A short reminder helps you catch that before you leave the telefon mining overnight.

You can turn this off anytime. The full guide is always available from Ustawienia or Urządzenie Informacja.

power.ambient_summary: Best mining is often around 18–28 °C room temperature. Hotter rooms need better cooling or Cooler profile.
power.ambient_detail:
Phones throttle or get unstable when they overheat. Aim for a cool room (about 18–28 °C).

Above ~28 °C: improve airflow, remove a case if needed, use Cooler profile, or pause when hot.

Below ~18 °C: usually fine for mining — cold air helps keep the chip cool.

This is a comfort tip for the room/environment, not the bateria % or in-app temperature pause settings.

Systemowe oszczędzanie energii jest wyłączone — preferowany stan dla hashrate i stabilnego połączenia z pulą.

Uwaga: bateria może się szybciej zużywać niż przy włączonym oszczędzaniu. Podłączaj zasilanie, gdy możesz. Niektóre telefony włączają oszczędzanie przy niskim % — wyłącz to, jeśli mining zwalnia w nocy.
power.power_save_detail_on:
Wiele telefonów ma osobny tryb oszczędzania baterii (to nie to samo co „bez ograniczeń” dla jednej aplikacji).

Gdy oszczędzanie jest WŁ., system często obniża taktowanie CPU i ogranicza sieć w tle — spada hashrate, pula może się rozłączyć.

Do miningu wyłącz Oszczędzanie energii (lub blokuj auto-włączanie). Lepiej do miningu, ale bateria może szybciej się wyczerpać.
